why: Yoink's tx 0x4f43fc6d (block 22722394, index 0, 06:18:59Z) is the first use of the mpETH mint-without-deposit bug (all 381 earlier mpETH mint events are fee or staking mints). The attacker cluster's first exploit tx is a test run 50 min later (0x691c8070, block 22722643, EOA 0xd08559ce) and the main flash-loan tx (0x57ee419a, block 22722911) 1 h 44 min later; the main-tx EOA held 0.0008 ETH until the test proceeds arrived, and none of the attacker's txs is in the public mempool archive. Nothing of the attacker's was pending, so Yoink neither front-ran nor replayed anyone: the press 'Yoink front-ran the attacker' is loose wording. The attacker's txs share the call grammar (mint with 0 ETH, pool swap, V3 leg, optional flash-funded depositETH) but no contract or calldata with Yoink's. Yoink returned its net 45.79 ETH to the Meta Pool admin EOA and got a 5 ETH reward; the 28.9 unbacked mpETH it swept to its vault was not returned. c0ffeebabe.eth made a small late copy one block after the attacker's main tx.
strength: block/tx order and balances of both attacker EOAs, full mpETH mint-event history, call-sequence diff of all four traces, return/reward txs and admin-EOA identity are all in saved raw data.
